journeys.title: 7 days to slow down
journeys.description: A week of small pauses. Nothing to fix, only to notice.

questions.text: What did you rush through today that could have waited?
Stop for a moment. What's the weather inside?
What did you do today at half your usual speed?
One word for the quietest minute of your day.
Three things you noticed only because you slowed down.
Tonight, a long dinner or an early night?
What will you keep from this slower week?

journeys.title: Gratitude
journeys.description: Seven days of small thank-yous, to people, places and plain things.

questions.text: Who did something kind for you lately?
Three ordinary things you'd miss if they vanished.
One word for what your body did well today.
Which place are you glad exists?
What did someone teach you, long ago, that you still use?
Today, more thankful for people or for quiet?
Write the thank-you you never got round to saying.

journeys.title: Unplugged
journeys.description: Five days with a little less screen and a little more world.

questions.text: When did you reach for a screen today without needing to?
What did you do with ten minutes of no screen at all?
Show me something you'd have missed looking at a screen.
A little less noise: how's the weather inside?
Which small habit from these days would you like to keep?

journeys.title: Season review
journeys.description: Five evenings to look back on the last three months, gently.

questions.text: The last three months, in one word?
Three moments from this season worth keeping.
What turned out better than you feared?
What would you like to leave behind with this season?
Write to the you of next season.
